faqs.q: How competitive is SEO in Estonia?
faqs.a: It depends on the niche. Tallinn tech keywords are tough, but Estonian-language local service keywords are often wide open. Small language markets reward whoever shows up with genuinely good content.

faqs.q: Should I target Russian-language searches too?
faqs.a: If your customers include Russian speakers, yes. It is a largely uncontested layer of search in Estonia, and a few solid Russian pages can capture queries competitors ignore completely.

faqs.q: How long until I see results?
faqs.a: Technical fixes and profile work can move local rankings within weeks. Content-driven growth typically shows in 2 to 4 months. Estonian markets compound quickly once foundations are right.

faqs.q: Do you work with startups or traditional businesses?
faqs.a: Both. Startups usually need English content and authority building; traditional businesses need Estonian local SEO and review systems. The audit tells us which levers matter for you.
